title: Expectation under a finite probability mass function
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f\colon\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. The expectation of $f$ under $p$ is $\sum_{x\in\Omega}p(x)f(x)$.
